lines: The mist laughs more the second time around. Wait for the real body to flare white. Don't rush.
The true letter arrived. One layer less of false fog.
Your eyes work better than they did the first time.
You're carrying the letter. Hand the real one over at the trader post on the Crossroads.
The mist has lifted. Your eyes will do.
…There's one more true letter. Too many forgeries — the real one goes by hand.
Strike a shadow and the shadow laughs at you. Look for the tell: the instant the blade lifts, that one is real.
The mirror hall is east of the village. White Fog is waiting for you to get lost.
Go to the inn first. Someone passed that letter all the way here… too slowly.
